description: This plot illustrates the relationship between Loss and TFLOPs for two models, Vanilla and SepLLM. The x-axis is labeled "TFLOPs" and uses a linear scale ranging from 0.00 to 1.25 with a multiplier of 1e9, featuring tick marks at intervals of 0.25. The y-axis is labeled "Loss" and uses a linear scale ranging from 2.40 to 2.75, with visible tick marks at intervals of 0.05. The "Vanilla" model is represented by a solid purple line with upward-pointing triangle markers, showing a steady decline across the x-axis. It begins off-chart above a loss of 2.75 at an x-value just below 0.10e9, drops to approximately 2.69 at 0.13e9 TFLOPs, continues to decrease through 2.58 at 0.50e9 TFLOPs, and ends at a loss of 2.50 at approximately 1.20e9 TFLOPs. The "SepLLM" model is represented by a solid red line with circular markers, which also exhibits a steady decline. This line begins off-chart above 2.75 at an x-value around 0.08e9, falls to approximately 2.64 at 0.13e9 TFLOPs, decreases to 2.54 at 0.50e9 TFLOPs, and concludes at a loss of approximately 2.47 at 1.20e9 TFLOPs. Additionally, the plot includes a green dashed horizontal line at a loss of 2.50. Green star markers indicate where this horizontal line intersects the SepLLM line at approximately 0.94e9 TFLOPs and the Vanilla line at approximately 1.20e9 TFLOPs. Green dashed vertical lines drop from these two intersection points toward the x-axis, and a green double-headed arrow labeled "1.28x" spans the horizontal distance between these vertical lines.
